headline: Downside Bitcoin Puts at 75k Drew the Bid Into the October 14 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew printed 28.29, with downside puts at 75k heavily bid against calls at 91k into the October 14 expiry. That pipe is a hedge: money is paying for protection under spot rather than chasing the higher strikes. Bitcoin traded near 83k, higher by 0.88 percent, while implied volatility sat at 37.9, the 84.6 percentile of the past 30 days.
author: jordan
